conventions.offset: Original signed TMP top-left relative to template origin, not tile center.
conventions.layerOrder: Retain diamond and extra separately. Extra may contain actual cliffs, rails and bridge structure.
conventions.assembled: Native pixels with TMP maxHeight-relative Y adjustment; no resampling, rotation, synthesis or repainting.
conventions.z: Original depth bytes retained; not interpreted as world elevation.
conventions.shore: Original shore templates are complete 2x2 patches at the water/land boundary, not separate vertical cliffs.
conventions.license: Original Westwood/EA game artwork; existing project authorization, no new redistribution license asserted.

evidence.method: Independent LCW decoding of original OverlayPack and OverlayDataPack, each 32 blocks / 262144 decoded bytes. OverlayTypes IDs are zero-based enumeration order, not the INI numeric keys. Decoded by effects teammate; no original game implementation copied.

X.placement: Place one entire native sprite per longitudinal X cell at tile(x, bridgeOriginY+1), never once per lane. Use the selected template's derived deck-plane anchor (90,35) relative to the projected tile top vertex; the original canvas-center convention (90,45) is retained separately as nativeCanvasCenterAnchor.

Y.placement: Place one entire native sprite per longitudinal Y cell at tile(bridgeOriginX+1,y), never once per lane. Use the selected template's derived deck-plane anchor (90,35) relative to the projected tile top vertex; the original canvas-center convention (90,45) is retained separately as nativeCanvasCenterAnchor.

excluded.wbrdge01: Ford / stepping stones, not a railed low bridge.
excluded.wbrdge02: Ford / stepping stones, not a railed low bridge.
excluded.ovrps: High overpass with original level-four deck and substantial supports, not compatible with a level-zero low bridge.
excluded.lobrdge: Not the bridge endpoints used by the verified map runs.

foregroundLayer.derivation: Original near-side edge and lower timber pixels only; no repainting. Excludes the deck interior. Geometric mask registered to deckPlaneCanvasQuad.

templates.anchorConvention: Derived native deck-plane registration for canonical level-zero bridge: source deck center (90,50) aligns to projected tile center (0,15), giving (90,35). Original canvas-center convention (90,45) is retained separately; this is not a claim about original engine offsets.

notes: Unused zero-offset frames retain their original headers, including compression 4; no pixels exist to decode.
Only populated format-3 frames are decoded, preserving palette indices and native canvas coordinates.
